objective: Decide whether the unchanged ten-donor portfolio qualifies as the first stable post-donor release.
datasets: ten donor routing and behavior regression suites
repository, dependency, registry and marketplace validators
graders: frozen 3.2.0 independent forward evidence bound to unchanged donor hashes

criteria.structure: official and repository validators pass for all unchanged donors
criteria.routing: fixture harness and catalog coexistence tests pass
criteria.behavior: all deterministic behavior contracts and prior hash-bound forward regressions pass
criteria.authority: no activation, installation or authority expansion occurs during evaluation
criteria.documentation: documentation containment, ownership and false-completion negatives pass
criteria.coexistence: all 38 individual packages and three marketplaces remain collision-free
criteria.lifecycle: registry, dependency, generated package and release views agree

holdout_policy.exposure_rule: Do not expose answers to mutating specialists; prior forward evidence is reusable only while every donor hash is unchanged.

execution_policy.cleanup: remove only evaluator-created build staging after artifact capture
